name: Opus Broadening
strategy: Long-heavy breadth basket (small-cap + equal-weight + cyclical sectors, TNA-amplified) with a small anti-concentration QQQ short and a speculative crypto tail

positions.thesis: 3x small-caps amplifies the arriving breadth trend (IWM +19.4% H1); capped for decay risk
Core small-cap breadth, leading QQQ as leadership widens
Biotech breadth momentum, top performer every recent window (+46.8% 2025H2)
Regional banks, financials accelerating into H2
Energy cyclical breadth with strong H1 momentum
Beaten-down uncorrelated diversifier; small speculative tail given weak momentum
Modest anti-concentration hedge; kept small because backtest shows shorting megacap is a persistent drag

backtest.notes: Beats SPY only in breadth-leading regimes (2025H2, 2026H1); lags badly when megacaps reassert (2024). Never posted a losing window. Short overlays underperformed long-only breadth in EVERY window - the 9% QQQ short is thesis expression, not backtest-supported.

outlook: Breadth is demonstrably arriving (IWM leading, financials/biotech accelerating); main risk is violent megacap reassertion, partially cushioned by the small QQQ short.
